name: Royale Velour Plush & Thick Toilet Paper
summary: An everyday bathroom-tissue supply for a household emergency shelf. The documented pack contains 12 physical rolls; 12 equals 24 is a regular-roll equivalence claim, not 24 physical rolls.
description: Sanitation planning is easier when ordinary supplies are included before an outage. Bathroom tissue belongs beside handwashing supplies and an appropriate waste plan, rather than being treated as a complete hygiene system on its own. This selected Velour pack is described as 12 physical rolls marketed as equivalent to 24 regular rolls. Size comparisons are marketing conventions, so inspect the selected pack and sheet count when comparing value. The concept artwork includes environmental wording; it does not independently establish certification or the footprint of the delivered pack.
